hero.title: About Us
hero.text: SEDES puts into practice the provision of Law No. 13,153/2015, under the National Policy to Combat Desertification and Mitigate the Effects of Drought (PNCD), to establish an integrated information system on these topics. The System is also part of the Brazilian Action Plan to Combat Desertification and Mitigate the Effects of Drought (PAB-Brazil), launched by the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MMA), and serves as a tool to support the production, integration and use of information for planning, monitoring and decision-making.
